Kiuruvesi, 122 road km from Kuopio, its nearest unit by drive time, faces 16 nights away with 15 breast sessions versus 6 with 5 [S60, S59].

1. The head of radiotherapy could evaluate a single 8 Gy session as default for uncomplicated bone metastases, with equal pain relief and more retreatment [S31, S30, S62]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews current bone protocols [S31, S62]. Kiuruvesi's expected nights away are 6.2 with multi-fraction courses versus 2.4 with 8 Gy [S60, S59]. It serves "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

2. The breast oncology lead could evaluate 5 sessions as default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall without nodal radiotherapy), non-inferior to 15 sessions [S9, S15]. Within 30 days, the clinical team reviews eligibility and distance as a reason for 5 sessions [S15]. Calculated for breast alone, this removes 61 nights away and frees 763 machine sessions yearly county-wide [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. It serves "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

3. The quality manager could evaluate yearly reports of schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band [S21]. Within 30 days, the quality manager and the clinical team decide which figures to report [S21]. It serves "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Figures use modelled distances and assumed schedules [S60, S57].
